title: Catch The Lightning
description: This mod adds a crafting ingredient that can be obtained by having a lightning hit a glass bottle. It can be used to make wind charges and electrum from Create: C&A.
body:
Glass bottles struck by lightning transform into a new item called "Lightning in a Bottle". This new item is used to craft wind charges and also electrum from Create: Crafts & Additions. Has limited Create integration.

⚠️ **Only works on ground items and depots - mechanical belts are NOT supported** ⚠️

This mod was created with the purpose of making grinding for electrum from C&A a bit less tedious. But then I also got an idea to make it useful in vanilla Minecraft too, so you can make wind charges pretty cheaply.

![Both recipes added by the mod.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee4fc022fc2fb1f6181aac9ceb6cc34ec2980303.png)
